title.narrative: Number of innovative technologies for resilient and sustainable agriculture selected and implemented through ideas competition.

description.narrative: Number of innovative technologies for resilient and sustainable agriculture selected and implemented through ideas competition. Number of technologies

comment.narrative: 25 of selected project proposals submitted by women.

Of the 44 reported technologiesprojects the progress as of September 2024 is as followsCoffee sectorA total of 21 technologies have been identified 10 of which are led by women. Of these one technology is fully implemented 10 are under implemenattion implementation progress more than 70 according to ICAFE and 8 up to 69 according to ICAFE. 2 have reached the contract signing phase. All projects are projected to be completed by January 2025.Livestock sectorIn this sector there are 23 technologies 14 of which are led by women. As of May 31 205 proposals were received. On September 11 the Selection Committee selected 23 ideas that were approved by the NAMA Livestock Technical Committee on September 25. FUNDECOOPERACION has all needed resources for supporting implementation and is engaged with the selected participants.

title.narrative: Amount of external financing provided under the matching scheme to the fund identified by the Action

description.narrative: The Actions contribution to the identified fund has been matched by additional contributions from other organizations and initiatives (1:1).

comment.narrative: The amount of the fund has not been defined yet.

In the livestock sector a matching fund scheme has been identified with Fundecooperacin through its project Upscaling ADAPTA2 from the Adaptation Fund The external amount contributed by Fundecooperacin is 280000 USD.For the Banana sector a matching fund scheme has also been established with ActivaCATIE at a 11 ratio. The external amount contributed by ActivaCATIE is 150000 USD. Source of funding of ACTIVACATIE is the national Development Bank System SBD Sistema Banco para el Desarrollo. In general SBD provides funding grants for SME. The basis for the calculation on the percentage is the amount mentioned in the DoA 300.000 EUR

title.narrative: Number of Public private partnerships (PPPs) established

description.narrative: Number of Public private partnerships (PPPs) established Number of PPP

comment.narrative: Until august 2024 GIZ was engaged in negotiations with at least 10 cooperatives companies in the coffee and livestock sector and reached cooperation agreements. These agreement were mainly formalized during the period september october. Until October 2024 8 Memorandum of Understanding were signed.6 agreements were established with cooperatives in the coffee sector Copeagri Coopedota Coopepilangosta Coopetarrazu Coopronaranjo and Volcaf.The remaining 4 are with cooperatives in the livestock sector Coopebrisas Coopepriscal Dos Pinos and Coopemontecillos.Additionally to that the Bank BAC the company Buena Vida are cooperating with GIZ and ICAFE regarding the development of regenrative coffee. A formal agreement has not been established yet.
